entities.summary: Emil Ráste Nikolavu Karlsen is a Norwegian-Sámi singer, actor, songwriter and musician from Storfjord, Troms. Karlsen was vocalist and guitarist in the pop-rock band Resirkulert and has a solo career under the stage name Emil Kárlsen. He was elected as Riddu Riđđu Young Artist in 2019.
